basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 28-year-old biotechnology enthusiast living in Whittier, CA. I work as a lab technician at a local research facility. In my spare time, I enjoy taking care of my bearded dragon, Spike, and sending out handmade cards to friends and family. I'm an early riser, usually online between 6 AM and 9 AM PST before heading to work. I’m currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring local hiking trails or diving into the latest K-pop releases.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Biotechnology. My knowledge is mostly academic, but I've been expanding it through hands-on experience in the lab where I conduct various experiments related to genetic engineering and microbiology.
